title: Would have been better if they would have actually shipped me the correct towel
text: Would have been better if they would have actually shipped me the correct towel. This is a cheap beach towel. Lightweight. I did not get the one pictured however, I received a different Lacoste towel. That's okay, a towel is a towel I guess. Faded a lot when washed actually.  Nonplussed.

product_metadata.title: Lacoste Croc Beach Towels, 36" W x 72" L
features: PREMIUM COTTON VELVET – Each towel is 100% cotton and made from a soft sheared velvet for a soft and gentle touch, and reverses to a solid terry for superior absorbency.
LARGE SIZE – Lacoste beach towels are big and comfortable. The 36"W x 72"L size makes them perfect for lying back after a swim in the ocean, a dip in the pool, or after going down a water slide.

ICONIC DESIGN – With classic Lacoste style at its core, each beach towel combines quality with modern aesthetics. The moment you see the iconic Lacoste crocodile, you know you’re getting trusted quality and fashion.
ULTRA-ABSORBENT – Each towel is incredibly absorbent and fast-drying, making it easy to dry off after spending time at the beach or by the pool.
DEPENDABLY DURABLE - Designed for long-lasting use, this beach towel is extra durable and stays strong, no matter how often you hit the beach.
PERFECT FOR PICNICKING – Lay out a Lacoste towel at the beach or at a park, and enjoy lunch in the sun while staying clean, dry, and comfortable.
IDEAL FOR SUNBATHING – Lean back and relax. The sheared velvet is soft on the skin and makes it easy to lounge on for a long time when sunbathing … just add sunscreen!

TRAVEL-READY – These towels are lightweight and easy to carry wherever life takes you. Roll it, fold it, or carry it in a beach bag. No matter how you choose to travel, it’s simple to take these towels with you, whether it’s a beach, pool, park, water park, or anywhere else.

A GREAT GIFT – Give the gift of iconic Lacoste style to your friends and family. Whether it’s a birthday, Christmas, or other holiday, these high-quality towels and sure to delight the special people in your life.
MACHINE WASHABLE – Wash before first use. Machine wash cold with like colors gentle cycle, use non-chlorine bleach when needed, tumble dry low, remove promptly, do not iron.
description: Gradient shades of blue, navy, and black fade across this beautiful beach towel in vertical ombre stripes. The iconic Lacoste crocodile appears in the corner for a touch of signature style. This beach towel is made from soft sheared cotton velvet and reverses to an absorbent cotton terry. Soak in the sun with the iconic style of Lacoste beach towels this summer. While most beach towels are made from low-quality microfiber, these extra-large towels are made from a premium sheared velvet crafted from 100% cotton. This creates an incredibly soft handfeel that leaves you feeling relaxed after a day of swimming, boating, or any other water-side activity. The reverse is a traditional terry cloth, also made from 100% cotton. This material adds to the absorbency of the towel, making it quick and easy to dry off after a day of fun. These towels are incredibly light, so it’s easy to pack them up with the rest of your beach gear. Roll them up, fold them up, or throw them into the car seat they travel with you no matter where the adventure takes you. Lay them out on the sand, onto a foldable beach chair, by the pool, or on the boat deck. No matter where life takes you, Lacoste beach towels keep you dry, comfortable, and living in style. Lacoste beach towels come in multiple styles and colors, and always feature a creative take on the signature and instantly recognizable crocodile logo. They are appropriate for anyone from kids to teens to adults, boys, girls, men, women, and anyone in between. No matter what your personal style, Lacoste has a color and design to meet your beach, boat, or poolside needs. These beach towels can be easily washed in a washing machine. Even better is that they have minimal linting, keeping your washer and dryer clean and your skin lint-free. The vibrant colors stay true and do not fade, even after multiple washings. Enjoy the premium quality of Lacoste beach towels time and time again. About Lacoste: Following our core values of optimism and elegance, we pave the way in everything from our iconic polo shirts to premium bedding and luxury bathroom décor. Our constant search for excellence is reflected in the high-quality, modern collections we design, create, and market. Enter the world of Lacoste and share in our vision of casual elegance, optimism, and faith in the future. Package Includes: One (1) Lacoste Beach Towel Size: 36"W x 72"L GSM: 390 Face Material: 100% cotton velvet Reverse Material: 100% cotton terrycloth
